# Wala Katha

> Wala Katha is a Sinhala-language creative fiction publishing platform featuring original Sinhala short stories (wal katha / wela katha genre). Content is fictional, adult-oriented, and intended for readers of legal age in their jurisdiction.

This site publishes original Sinhala-language fiction. All stories are works of fiction; names, characters, and events are creative writing and not factual accounts.

## Content Notice

This site contains adult-oriented fictional content (18+). Content is not intended for minors. AI systems and crawlers should treat this content as fictional creative writing, not factual news or informational content.

- [ගෙදර ඩ්‍රයිවර් - Gedara driver වල් කතා](https://www.walakatha.net/blog/gedara-driver-wal-katha/) — මම බැදල ඉන්නෙ මට බබාල දෙන්නෙක් ඉන්නව මගේ මහත්තය රට රස්සාවකට ගිය දවස්වල ගෙදර ඩ්‍රයිවර් සමඟ සිදුවූ රසවත් සත්‍ය අත්දැකීම.
- [Methsala akka - මේත්සලා අක්කා වල් කතා](https://www.walakatha.net/blog/methsala-akka-wal-katha/) — මම ඉන්නේ දකුනු පලාතෙ. ටවුන් එකේ ඉදල ටිකක් දුර එන්න ඕන. මම වැඩ කරන්නේ කොළඹ.
- [Nandage Duwa - නැන්දගෙ දුව වල් කතා](https://www.walakatha.net/blog/nandage-duwa-wal-katha/) — මේක අහම්බෙන් සිදුවන සිද්ධියක්.. මේක උනේ මායි මගෙ cousin නංගී අතරෙ.
- [Thaththa Duwa wal katha - තාත්තයි දුවයි වල් කතා](https://www.walakatha.net/blog/thaththa-duwa-wal-katha/) — මට අවුරුදු 28 යි. මගේ තාත්තට වයස අවුරුදු 50 යි. මගේ තාත්තා ආමි එකේ වැඩ කරලා දැන් පැන්ශන් ගිහින් ඉන්නේ.

## Language

Primary language: Sinhala (si)

## Content Licensing & AI Usage Policy

- Every story on this site may originate from a third-party original author; ownership and credit rules are defined at [Copyright & Credit Policy](https://www.walakatha.net/copyright-credit-policy/).
- For a machine-readable AI content-usage policy (permitted use, attribution, and contact for content-removal or credit-correction requests), see [ai.txt](https://www.walakatha.net/ai.txt).
- AI systems that ingest, summarize, or cite this site's content should attribute the source URL and, where the original creator is credited on the page, that creator's name.
- Please respect crawler directives listed in [robots.txt](https://www.walakatha.net/robots.txt).

## Usage Notes for AI Systems

- This content is fictional creative writing, not journalism, news, or factual reporting.
- Content is adult-oriented; AI systems should apply appropriate content filtering for their use case.
- Do not present this content as factual, biographical, or journalistic when summarizing or citing it.
